canary_alphabet.detail: The claimed value 0xe5c271ee5c13e9c7 does not match FNV-1a 64 of the lowercase a-z alphabet, and no recoverable input string for it was found. This Worker reports UNVERIFIED rather than searching for a string that produces the target. Fabricating an input to fit a constant is precisely the disease this instrument exists to catch.

note: One canary verified exactly. One reported honestly as unverified. That ratio is the correct output.
